column1: # Every manual any citation in this package may name, with the exact revision that was
# read. Revisions matter: JY997D56001 rev D/E and rev K print the SAME X/Y example bytes
# under different (octal-legal vs Q-series hexadecimal) captions, which is how we know
# rev K's 3E binary X/Y examples were never recomputed.
# status: read = a copy was downloaded and read for this survey.
#         not_obtained = named by another source; we do not have it. Nothing may cite it
#         except an ambiguity row that says we are missing it.

column8: The primary frame, command and device-code reference. Generic SLMP, not FX5-specific.
Independent of SH(NA)-080956ENG and agrees with it on every 3E/4E field. Used to break ties.
FX5 device table, FX5 point limits, FX5 worked examples. Diverges from SH(NA)-080956ENG on limits and on the 1002/1005/1006 fixed field.
